redacted_subject: User asked us to erase their data
redacted_body:
Hi,

I look after our account at Fennimore Freight. A user in our workspace asked us to erase their personal data under GDPR. Deactivating them seems to keep their name and messages.

We could not find a delete option for user data in the admin area.

A reply in the next few days would be great. How do we do this correctly?

Regards,
[NAME_1]

Hello support,

Just wanted to say thanks to your support team for the help with our setup last week.

The person who answered explained everything clearly and patiently. Really appreciated. Our team is very happy with the app.

Keep it up!

Thanks,
[NAME_1]

Good morning,

I ask you to erase all personal data about me under Article 17 GDPR.

My account was under the Nimbleford Dental workspace.

We would like this sorted before the end of the week. Thank you.

Kind regards,
[NAME_1]

Hello,

I would like to apply for a position on your support team.

My CV is attached. I have four years of experience in SaaS support. I enjoy solving technical problems and explaining them in plain language.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Regards,
[NAME_1]

redacted_subject: Need a signed DPA before renewal
redacted_body:
Hi,

Writing on behalf of Fennimore Freight. Before our renewal, we need your DPA and details on where our data is stored and which sub-processors you use.

We are an EU company, so the transfer terms matter to us. Our renewal is in three weeks.

We would like this sorted before the end of the week. Please send the documents or a link.

Thanks,
[NAME_1]
IT lead, Fennimore Freight

Hi folks,

We are hosting a webinar on customer operations next month and would love someone from your team on the panel.

The session is 45 minutes and fully online. We expect a few hundred people from operations and support teams to attend.

Who could I talk to about this?

Many thanks,
[NAME_1]

redacted_subject: Urgent: data subject request from a former employee
redacted_body:
Hello support,

A former employee filed a data subject request with us, and we need to export everything your platform holds about them. Our deadline is tomorrow.

We already searched the help center.

This is blocking us right now, so we need help today. Please tell us how to get the export today.

Regards,
[NAME_1]

Good morning,

I'm [NAME_1] from Velloran SAS. We help software companies grow organic traffic with link building and content.

I would love 15 minutes of your time next week.

Who is the right person to talk to?

Best regards,
[NAME_1]

Hey team,

Under GDPR Article 15, I request a copy of all personal data you hold about me.

I used your app through my former employer, Ottervale Software. Please include where the data came from and who it was shared with.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Please confirm receipt and the expected timeline.

Many thanks,
[NAME_1]
head of finance, Ottervale Software

Hi,

Sorry, my previous message was meant for a colleague, not for you.

Please disregard it. You can throw it away. Our accounting firm has a very similar address, so the autocomplete picked yours.

Sorry for the trouble.

Thanks,
[NAME_1]

Hi folks,

I am a California resident and, under the CCPA, I opt out of the sale or sharing of my personal information.

I am a user in the Velloran SAS workspace. This also covers any advertising partners.

Please confirm once this is done.

Thanks so much!
[NAME_1]

Dear support,

We are offering free, high-quality articles for your blog in return for one link back to Glimmerbrook BV.

All articles are original and written by people with industry experience. Our writers cover productivity and remote work.

Let me know if you are interested.

Yours sincerely,
[NAME_1]

Hello support,

Your records still show my old surname. Under GDPR I ask you to correct it in all your systems.

My account is part of the Glimmerbrook BV workspace.

No rush on this, whenever you have a moment. Thank you.

Regards,
[NAME_1]

Hello,

Please close my account and remove everything you have about me from your systems. And stop charging my card from now on.

[NAME_1]
